result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products with zero quantity, so the WH-1 example shows only "Bolt 10". The full suite passes offline (608 tests, build success). I did not commit.

- **Fix:** `DataStore.listStockByWarehouse` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, around line 1490) gets a `AND s.quantity > 0` filter, matching the other stock overviews. `findStockQuantity` is unchanged, so asking for the nut quantity in WH-1 still returns 0.
- **Test:** I added `warehouseStockOmitsProductsWithNothingLeft` to `src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/StockOverviewTest.java`. It follows your example: nuts taken to zero, screws set to zero, and the stock list checked against only "Bolt 10", plus the nut quantity check.

Choice I made: a product whose count is zero is dropped from the stock list. Since `StockService.getWarehouseStock` is the only caller and the demo just prints the list, no other code depended on the zero rows.
